name: hcportal_kennelDraftLookup
description: New kennel from a website (E12.F1.S10): the KennelFromWebsite API's gate (checked before it fetches a page or calls the AI), plus possible duplicates (live kennels and open requests — EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport RequestStatus 0/1 — with the same website, name or short name) and our city rows matching the place the site names. Reads only. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token (standard param string), validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: websiteUrl
parameters.description: Compared as host+path, ignoring http/https, www. and trailing slashes; held in an NVARCHAR(500) local, and ignored when shorter than 4 characters after normalising.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(MAX) parameter vs Kennel.KennelWebsiteUrl NVARCHAR(500); the normalised value is assigned to an NVARCHAR(500) local (line 71), so a longer URL is silently truncated before comparison.

parameters.name: kennelName
parameters.description: Exact-match candidate for Kennel.KennelName / request KennelName. Trimmed; blank = not given.

parameters.name: kennelShortName
parameters.description: Exact-match candidate for KennelShortName or KennelUniqueShortName (requests: KennelShortName). Trimmed; blank = not given.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Name or accent-free name; prefix match from 3 letters.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success = 0 with ErrorMessage on auth failure or missing CanEditKennel (then no further rowsets). Success = 1, ErrorMessage NULL, is sent first on success and rowsets 1-3 follow. A runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: Duplicates
rowsets.description: At most 10: kennels matching on website first (rank 0), then kennels matching on name/short name (rank 1), then open requests (rank 2); ties by name.

columns.name: slug
columns.description: KennelUniqueShortName, or the request's short name

columns.name: website
columns.description: Kennel.KennelWebsiteUrl or the request's KennelUrl, as stored

rowsets.name: CityCandidates
rowsets.description: At most 8 live cities (only when @city is given), score DESC then CityName. Matched on CityName or City_ASCII exactly, or by prefix from 3 letters.

columns.name: score
columns.description: 100 exact in region+country, 90 exact in country, 70 exact with no country given, 50 prefix in country

rowsets.name: Country
rowsets.description: 0 or 1 row: the live country matched by CountryName (preferred) or CountryCode.

sideEffects: On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then THROW

codeSmells.detail: Line 71: @websiteUrl (NVARCHAR(MAX)) is LOWER/TRIMmed into DECLARE @site NVARCHAR(500); a longer URL is truncated silently and could then match a different site. Read-only, so the cost is a wrong duplicate hint.

Lines 71-77, 85-88 and 93-96 repeat the http/https/www/trailing-slash normalisation; the variable version strips every trailing slash, the CTE versions only one, so 'a.org//' and 'a.org/' compare differently.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
